 Order
This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.352/2014 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Palam Village, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. The marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnized on 27.11.2010 in accordance with Hindu rites and ceremonies.
On 08.10.2013 a male child namely Master Ritesh was born from the said wedlock.

Because of temperamental differences both the husband and wife started living separately and on a complaint of respondent no.2 before CAW Cell on 03.07.2014, the present FIR was registered.
3.
On 09.06.2017 the disputes between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 were resolved and a settlement deed was entered into between the parties on the said date.
It is submitted since 20.11.2017 the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 are residing together in a rented accommodation at Village Dabri, New Delhi.

4. The respondent no.2 is present today and has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and she has no objection in case the FIR is quashed as the matter is settled between them and she is residing happily and peacefully with her husband.
The affidavits of parties are on record.
The learned APP for the State also has no objection in case the FIR is quashed.

sentences.text: In view of the above settlement between the parties, there is no impediment in quashing the present FIR as it would never entail in conviction of the petitioners herein.
6. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.352/2014 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Palam Village, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom stands quashed.
Pending application(s), if any, also stands disposed of.
